status: E1 single-run, controlled synthetic tool use; NOT accepted DEC model benchmark
scoring_revision: v1.1 posthoc; both original and corrected scores retained per case

description.en: Five small instruction models after complete loading and warm-up; 12 English exact-output tasks and 12 English API tool-use/no-tool tasks per model. Real structured tool_calls invoke deterministic synthetic functions and the results return to model history.
description.fa: آزمون پنج مدل پس از بارگذاری کامل و Warm-up، شامل ۱۲ پرسش صرفاً انگلیسی برای پیروی از دستور و ۱۲ سناریوی انگلیسی Tool Calling و عدم‌فراخوانی ابزار برای هر مدل. فراخوانی واقعی ابزار ساختاریافته با اجرای تابع روی داده مصنوعی و بازگرداندن نتیجه به مدل انجام شد.

environment.model_execution_host: authorized CPU-only laboratory host, private details withheld
environment.isolation: separate ephemeral localhost model server per candidate
environment.sampling: manufacturer-aware; settings retained per model, not uniform across checkpoints
environment.parallelism: LFM3 originally ran first; other four tests were concurrent on distinct ports with each 4 CPU threads. Do not directly rank observed latency.
environment.security: Only fictional fixtures, no real weather/order/store, no LDI access, no production tool execution, no other services changed

tool_execution_criteria: Model must emit a structured tool_calls API entry (not JSON/XML/plain text)
Function names and all required typed arguments must match expected task
Harness dispatches function to a deterministic synthetic fixture and sends its result to the model
Model must generate factually correct final message from the fixture; two control tasks must not call a tool
Posthoc fixture rule correction accepts semantically correct answers without redundant city/order/item names where prompt did not require them

evaluation.instruction_exact: one point for exact expected format and content, no extra text
evaluation.original_tool_strict: runner's first-pass exact answer substring rule
evaluation.revised_tool_criterion: posthoc v1.1 transparent deterministic fixture relevance rule
limits: one run per scenario and model, unblinded criterion revision after output inspection
simple synthetic English questions and functions are not representative of full agent reliability
heuristic final answer validation can misclassify semantic equivalents, independent review required
model-specific sampling, reasoning caps, prompt templates, GGUF quantization and mixed concurrent host load
Tool schema parser compatibility is runtime-dependent (MiniCPM vendor recommends SGLang parser)
No RAG/LDI, LoRA, specialist domain evaluations or actual DEC cognitive council tested
